caption:
Toto plays two games of padel straight after work, and the next day the side and shoulder feel stiff.

Padel is full of quick turns, lunges and overhead shots. A proper warm-up and good trunk and leg control can help the body handle it.

Hybi's padel Pilates: side-lying trunk rotation 8 each side, single-leg bridge 8 each side, single-leg balance 30 seconds each side, side plank 20 seconds × 2. Two to three times a week.

Sudden calf pain on court or elbow pain that lingers is worth an assessment first. Clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🎾
